watson.name: Watson
watson.blurb: Cramped megabuildings, noodle markets, and the smell of ozone where Maelstrom huddles.

westbrook.name: Westbrook
westbrook.blurb: Neon clubs, corpo pride, and the Afterlife where legends get buried in cheap booze.

citycenter.name: City Center
citycenter.blurb: Glass towers that scrape the sky and prices that scrape your soul.

heywood.name: Heywood
heywood.blurb: Barrio heat, shotgun sermons, and Valentino turf you don't wander into twice.

pacifica.name: Pacifica
pacifica.blurb: Abandoned resorts and truce-less alleys. The city's bleeding edge, literally.

santo.name: Santo Domingo
santo.blurb: Heavy industrial grime. The sound of factories, shotguns, and 6th Street bombas.

badlands.name: Badlands
badlands.blurb: Open desert, dead towns, and the yowl of nomad engines under a full moon.

megabuilding-h10.name: Megabuilding H10 — Apartment
megabuilding-h10.desc: Your shoebox in the sky. A synth-leather couch retracts from the wall, a cracked window looks out over Watson's neon soup, and the fridge hums a note of sad B-flat. Someone wrote 'WAKE THE F**K UP' in the condensation on the bathroom mirror.

watson-streets.name: Watson — Shibobu Street
watson-streets.desc: Crowded connective tissue of Watson. Hologram ads babble over ramen carts, a braindance kiosk hisses static, and a wetsuit-streaked copter grumbles by overhead. Everything has a price sticker, including the air.

kabuki-market.name: Kabuki Market
kabuki-market.desc: A neon flea-circus. Vendors hawk bootleg braindances, chrome connections, and noodles older than your childhood. The air smells of soy grease and bad decisions. Gangoons lean on crates, watching everyone and no one.

little-china.name: Watson — Little China
little-china.desc: Lanterns, wire-wrapped shutters, and a noodle stall doing brisk business at 3 AM. A Maelstrom skimmer is half-parked on the sidewalk, its engine ticking like a stopped clock. Someone got gel-tagged 'UNFAIR PRICE' on a vending machine.

northside.name: Watson — Northside
northside.desc: Industrial rooftops and shuttered docks. This is where Maelstrom coils around the rusted ribs of the city. Every shadow holds a trashed drone; every drone might hold a surprise.

objects.name: subnet access terminal
objects.desc: A battered Arasaka wall-port bolted to a generator shack. Blue light pulses behind a scarred metal flap.

warehouse-district.name: Watson — Warehouse District
warehouse-district.desc: A row of dented container-warehouses. One has a fresh SIGURD SECURITY wax seal, another has a door swung open, dripping light. The kind of place cargo goes missing from, and people go missing in.

objects.name: scav crater
objects.desc: A crate with a busted lock, spilling synth-spray cans.

objects.name: subnet splice node
objects.desc: A dangling network splice dripping signal like static rain. Wiring for the whole district flows through it.

maelstrom-den.name: Maelstrom Den
maelstrom-den.desc: A gutted factory floor painted in strobe-light graffiti. Maelstrom chromeheads twitch around a holo-rig, wired to the shop. The air smells of coolant and metal-grind. You are not welcome.

objects.name: Maelstrom rig node
objects.desc: A chrome skull wired into the den's local net. Its eye-socket LED daemon is staring back at you with intent.

scav-den.name: Scav Hideout
scav-den.desc: A yanked-open shipping container lined with stolen chrome and opias. Knives in the wall gaps, an operating table with a drip bag, and the smell of pasteurization gone wrong. Scavs squint at you like inventory.

ripperdoc-watson.name: Ripperdoc — Watson
ripperdoc-watson.desc: A sunken clinic with a proper barber chair and a monitor full of vitals you don't have. The ripper's gloves are on something alive or recently alive. They nod at you the way surgeons nod.

japantown.name: Westbrook — Japantown
japantown.desc: Westbrook's neon prayer mat. Geisha drones holo-dance above izakaya lanterns while Tyger Claws watch from alley mouths. Overstimulation is the city's official religion here.

charter-hill.name: Westbrook — Charter Hill
charter-hill.desc: Charter Hill's glass condos stare down at you like disappointed elders. Security drones streak the pavement, keeping the streets 'family-safe,' which is to say, empty of anything fun.

north-oak.name: Westbrook — North Oak
north-oak.desc: Manicured and sterile above the city's underbelly. Private pools, racecars, and the unshakeable suspicion that everyone here knows a netrunner who knows you.

cloud-bar.name: Cloud — Dollhouse
cloud-bar.desc: Pink light, perfume-tinted fog, and dolls who remember things you didn't say. The vending wall is stocked with premium chrome and better ghosts. Drinks are twice the price and worth half.

objects.name: Cloud dollhouse router
objects.desc: A pink-lit comms rink tucked behind the bar. The dolls' personalities live on the other side, endlessly uploading.

afterlife-bar.name: The Afterlife
afterlife-bar.desc: Legendary merc dive carved out of a morgue. Every booth is a monument to somebody's final run, and Rogue's seat at the bar is the only throne in Night City that means anything.

objects.name: Afterlife terminal
objects.desc: Rogue's private booth terminal. A memorial playlist for the dead runs on loop behind the ledger.

ripperdoc-westbrook.name: Ripperdoc — Westbrook
ripperdoc-westbrook.desc: A glass mezzanine clinic with gentlemen's-club lighting. Cosmetic-chrome is the specialty: teeth, eyes, and the kind of implants that get you out of traffic stops.

citycenter-streets.name: City Center — Delugium Street
citycenter-streets.desc: The aorta of Corporate Plaza. Walkers drift past ninety-foot holo-ads selling cleanliness, sleep, and revolution as package deals. Every step is photographed and monetized.

downtown.name: City Center — Downtown
downtown.desc: Corpo ants in thousand-eddie suits hurry between towers. A street preacher on a soapbox shouts about the Machine. A concession bot sells 'Authentic Poverty Experience' bobbleheads.

objects.name: public net kiosk
objects.desc: A municipal kiosk promising 'one free credit.' The city's generosity is, predictably, a lie with a keyhole.

corpo-plaza.name: Corpo Plaza
corpo-plaza.desc: Drone-lit marble and fifty-meter glass. The Arasaka obelisk sulks against the skyline. Guards with mirror faces watch you the way accountants audit: completely, and without feeling.

objects.name: Arasaka fiber tap
objects.desc: A mirrored data stack inside a glass podium. The guard pretends not to see the port. He sees it.

arasaka-waterfront.name: Arasaka Waterfront
arasaka-waterfront.desc: Loading docks under corporate surveillance, where crates of prototype chrome change hands and cameras never blink. A ferry hums against the pier, carrying the authorized and the almost-caught.

objects.name: harbor master uplink
objects.desc: A harbor control uplink buzzing with shipping manifests. Cameras never blink; this one also records your typing.

emblers-hotel.name: Embers
emblers-hotel.desc: A rooftop bar that smells of orchids and insider trading. Below, the whole of Night City shimmers like a wound. Drinks are brought by drones; secrets are brought by you.

ripperdoc-citycenter.name: Ripperdoc — City Center
ripperdoc-citycenter.desc: A sterile, premium suite with a branding team and a compliance screen. The ripper here is six franchised verbs and a laser. It'll cost you the expensive kind of silence.

wellsprings.name: Heywood — Wellsprings
wellsprings.desc: Green-lit walkways and wall murals of dead saints. Vendors trade in pre-war mezcal and vintage Valentino tees. The static of a far-off radio sings in Spanish between gunshots and sales pitches.

the-glen.name: Heywood — The Glen
the-glen.desc: The Glen: murals, murk, and the press of old money and older grudges. A shotgun's pump or a burrito wrapper — one of those drops on every corner.

vista-del-rey.name: Heywood — Vista Del Rey
vista-del-rey.desc: Terraced housing that spectacularly fails to see a king or a view, but sees plenty of Valentino tail-light interviews. A cyberpsycho warning has been stenciled on the last working bus stop.

valentinos-den.name: Valentino Compound
valentinos-den.desc: Tight streets and open windows with telltale curtain-tugs. Rosary-tatted Valentinos stalk between bikes and incense bowls. The only way to leave smoothly is to have never been printed on an entry log.

objects.name: candle-wired altar port
objects.desc: Devotional candles wired into a parish net. The faithful upload prayers; you'll upload something louder.

stadium.name: Heywood — Grand Imperial Mall
stadium.desc: A stadium repurposed into Night City's biggest flea market. Stalls curve like rows of a concrete shark's mouth, selling butcher-blade chrome, bootleg fails, and hope at half price.

objects.name: stallholder net hub
objects.desc: A striker that takes five eddie coins and grants 'one layer of the net.' The market loves a gimmick.

ripperdoc-heywood.name: Ripperdoc — Heywood
ripperdoc-heywood.desc: A converted botanica with saints on one wall and scalpels on the other. The ripper suspends judgment for a price, and blessed steel goes in clean.

heywood-streets.name: Heywood — Arroyo Overpass
heywood-streets.desc: An overpass where the city's exhaust meets the barrio's soul. Brakes hiss, radios salsa, and below the guard rail the wreckage of a hopper smolders politely.

coastview.name: Pacifica — Coastview
coastview.desc: Swept-clean sidewalks leading to shuttered hotels. A wetsuit-clad fixer posts job QR codes on a lamppost. Faint surf drowns out the sounds of the city's neglect.

pacifica-streets.name: Pacifica — Afterlife Gate
pacifica-streets.desc: The neon ends here. The grid peters out into palm trees and parking structure skeletons. Everything's been stripped for chrome, then stripped for the stripping.

west-wind-estate.name: Pacifica — West Wind Estate
west-wind-estate.desc: An unfinished housing estate frozen mid-collapse. Wind rakes through rebar and half-walls of graffiti. Sometimes the graffiti moves.

objects.name: survey drone uplink
objects.desc: Construction scaffolding strung with drone-charging cables. Half the wiring is load-bearing; the other half is unguarded.

abandoned-resort.name: Pacifica — Abandoned Resort
abandoned-resort.desc: A skeletal beach resort. A swimming pool has become a cistern of black water, and something with too many lenses pads around the penthouse. The last tourist left a decade ago. Something else stayed.

objects.name: resort security core
objects.desc: A drowned server rack in the old security office. Something up in the penthouse breathes into the same subnet you're about to enter.

cyberpsycho-den.name: Pacifica — Penthouse Nest
cyberpsycho-den.desc: The resort's penthouse, now a cyberpsycho's nest. Chrome splayed like a melted chandelier, and a figure in ruins breathing in time with the flickering lights. Its eyes track you with predatory patience.

arroyo.name: Santo Domingo — Arroyo
arroyo.desc: Streets that taste like diesel and dry heat. Noodle trucks park between transport depots, and the skyline is a chorus of steel mills and party lights from the wrong end of town.

rancho-coronado.name: Santo Domingo — Rancho Coronado
rancho-coronado.desc: Worker blocks stacked like dominoes, drying laundry strung over balconies like victory banners. A 6th Street bombazo is scratching on a nearby roof, spinning protest records.

santo-streets.name: Santo Domingo — Refinery Row
santo-streets.desc: Refinery plumbing weeps steam into the streetlights. Buses thundering past, workers in yellow vests, and the distant clank of an assembly line folding steel like origami.

objects.name: refinery SCADA port
objects.desc: A refinery control rack sweating steam. It runs the compressors, the cameras, and — if you're fast — anything you want it to.

6th-street-den.name: 6th Street Firebase
6th-street-den.desc: A fortified vet-barf where 6th Street runs drills and laments the good old days of manual guns. Ammo crates double as furniture. An American flag, threadbare, flies above an inspirational bombicide poster.

objects.name: firebase radio mast
objects.desc: A mast wired into the firebase's comms. Below it, veterans swap war stories and ammo in equal measure.

ripperdoc-santo.name: Ripperdoc — Santo Domingo
ripperdoc-santo.desc: A converted machine-shop that still smells of cutting oil. The ripper's chair is bolted to a lifting platform. No nonsense, no sedation — just steel and honesty.

badlands-crossroads.name: Badlands — Crossroads
badlands-crossroads.desc: A cracked highway interchange with a decommissioned gas station kept alive by generator and spite. Dust devils roller-skate between the pumps. The city hums behind you like a neon migraine.

nomad-camp.name: Badlands — Nomad Camp
nomad-camp.desc: A convoy of armored haulers circled in the dust. Nomads cook over open copper, kids tag the air with drones, and the horizon hums with the road's endless invitation.

objects.name: convoy mesh uplink
objects.desc: A lo-band mesh relay strung between the rigs. Dakota would charge you for what's on the other side. She won't mind if you take it yourself.

raider-flats.name: Badlands — Raider Flats
raider-flats.desc: A scrub-flat of burned vehicles and rusted horse trailers. Nomad raiders in bolt-scrap armor are stripping a wrecked van. They hear your engine before they see you, and they're already smiling.

dead-waste.name: Badlands — Dead Waste
dead-waste.desc: A dump of melted cargo containers and spent batteries. Toxic haze shimmers off the sand. Fashionable purple sunsets do not wash away what this place smells like.

objects.name: spilled crate
objects.desc: A crate that's been cracked open and rain-buffed. Something glints inside.

quarantine.name: Badlands — Quarantine Station
quarantine.desc: An old bio-quarantine station, doors sealed, stamps peeling. Someone's left a cooler of cold synth-beer out front, which in the Badlands is either a trap or a public service.

objects.name: quarantine uplink post
objects.desc: A sealed bio-uplink stamped with decommissioned chains. Old outbreak data hums inside like a caged heartbeat.
